role: Bootstrap and configuration for the proc:assert_fact ProceduralTemplate node in the knowledge graph's semantic domain.
detail: Defines the six-step semantic teaching pipeline (validate_parse, call_pt10, check_contradiction, create_edge, update_scope_count, generate_response) as ProcedureStep metadata nodes. The bootstrap_assert_fact_template() async function idempotently creates the ProceduralTemplate node proc:assert_fact (domain=semantic, routed to SemanticTeachingHandler), six child ProcedureStep nodes with semantic_action step_type, HAS_PROCEDURE_BODY and HAS_OPERAND edges linking them in sequence, and a DEPENDS_ON edge to the SemanticDomain node. All nodes use TAUGHT_PROCEDURE provenance (confidence=1.0). The function checks idempotency by looking up the template node and skips if it exists. On error, raises BootstrapError except for the DEPENDS_ON edge which logs a warning (non-fatal, expected if P1.8-E1 has not run). Returns AssertFactBootstrapResult with template_created, steps_created, and edges_created counts.
gotchas: DEPENDS_ON edge to domain:semantic is non-fatal if P1.8-E1 bootstrap has not run; logs warning instead of raising. The six steps are metadata configuration nodes (step_type=semantic_action), not computational AST nodes -- SemanticTeachingHandler dispatches by action_name. Graph structure uses HAS_OPERAND edges with position properties for sequential chaining, not nested operands. Idempotency relies on checking for existing template node; full step tree and edges assumed present if template exists (no partial rebuild).
